name: Scutosaurus Shield-Beast
journal_prompt: A massive, bone-plated pareiasaur. The Asura bred its line as living shield-walls tens of millions of years ago; now it grazes feral by old earthworks, or hauls stone for whoever has tamed it.
appearance: A Permian pareiasaur: a massive, low, barrel-bodied herbivore covered in bony plates, often wearing weathered leather and brass harness from the work it is put to now.
